mapper.insert: INSERT INTO underpass_event (underpass_id, event_type, risk_level, risk_score_at_event, operator_id) VALUES (#{underpassId}, #{eventType}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskScoreAtEvent}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT risk_level FROM underpass_event WHERE underpass_id = #{underpassId} AND event_type = 'RISK_LEVEL_UP' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
